content: GCC conversion research (Bowaba Jul 2025; Campaign Middle East / AAC Nissan via 360Dialog; Wati/Bowaba) shows WhatsApp click-to-chat outperforming form-only funnels in UAE/KSA/Kuwait/Qatar because it matches mobile habit and cuts form friction. Live production/exhibition sites in Dubai (Spectrum WhatsApp widget, Al Safa Chat with a Lead Designer, Beyond DXB Chat on WhatsApp, Arvento FAQ points to website or WhatsApp) treat WhatsApp as default. Western premium houses (Extraordinary) use form+phone/email only. For a GCC production house selling to corporates, dual path is the fit: qualifying form captures a brief for email follow-up; WhatsApp matches how the market actually replies. Do not replace the site with ads-to-chat only.
